Brady's full interview with Lai-Sheng Wang, who led the discovery of the Boron buckminsterfullerene. Main video is at https://youtu.be/y7l6yt5Wm-Q
More links and info in full description ↓↓↓

Lai-Sheng Wang is based at Brown University. His research was supported by the US National Science Foundation.

The paper Boron buckminsterfullerene : https://pubs.rsc.org/en/content/articlelanding/2026/sc/d6sc02674e
